```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r}
# Load libraries
pacman::p_load(dplyr, ggplot2, tidyr, tidyverse, lme4,lmerTest,emmeans, performance, broom.mixed, DHARMa)
```

```{r}
# Read dataset
df <- read.csv("Data_batches.csv")
```

```{r}
# Summary stats for numeric traits by treatment
summary_stats <- df %>%
  group_by(treatment) %>%
  summarise(
    n_fish = n(),
    mean_mass1 = mean(Body_mass1, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_mass1   = sd(Body_mass1, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_mass2 = mean(body_mass2, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_mass2   = sd(body_mass2, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_length = mean(body_length, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_length   = sd(body_length, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

print(summary_stats)

# Count of males and females per treatment
sex_counts <- df %>%
  group_by(treatment, sex) %>%
  summarise(n = n()) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = sex, values_from = n, values_fill = 0)

print(sex_counts)

# Overall descriptive stats for all numeric variables
overall_summary <- df %>%
  summarise(
    mean_mass1 = mean(Body_mass1, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_mass1   = sd(Body_mass1, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_mass2 = mean(body_mass2, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_mass2   = sd(body_mass2, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_length = mean(body_length, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_length   = sd(body_length, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

print(overall_summary)
```

```{r}
# Boxplot: Body mass before LPS injection
ggplot(df, aes(x = treatment, y = Body_mass1, fill = treatment)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  labs(title = "Body mass before LPS injection",
       x = "Treatment",
       y = "Body mass (g)") +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
# Reshape data into long format
df_long <- df %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(Body_mass1, body_mass2),
               names_to = "measurement",
               values_to = "mass")

# Create boxplot
ggplot(df_long, aes(x = treatment, y = mass, fill = measurement)) +
  geom_boxplot(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8)) +
  labs(title = "Body mass before and after LPS injection",
       x = "Treatment",
       y = "Body mass (g)",
       fill = "Measurement") +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
# Reshape data into long format
df_long <- df %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(Body_mass1, body_mass2),
               names_to = "measurement",
               values_to = "mass")

# Boxplot split by sex
ggplot(df_long, aes(x = treatment, y = mass, fill = measurement)) +
  geom_boxplot(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8)) +
  facet_wrap(~ sex) +
  labs(title = "Body mass before and after LPS injection by sex",
       x = "Treatment",
       y = "Body mass (g)",
       fill = "Measurement") +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
# Factor setup (set your preferred reference levels)
df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    treatment = factor(treatment, levels = c("control","low","high")),
    sex       = factor(sex),
    tank      = factor(tank),
    fish_id   = factor(fish_id)
  )

# For Type-III tests, use sum-to-zero contrasts
options(contrasts = c("contr.sum", "contr.poly"))
```

```{r}
# =========================
# 1) Repeated-measures LMM
# =========================
# Long format (before/after)
df_long <- df %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(Body_mass1, body_mass2),
    names_to = "measurement",
    values_to = "mass"
  ) %>%
  mutate(measurement = factor(measurement, levels = c("Body_mass1","body_mass2")))

# Model: mass ~ treatment * measurement * sex + random intercepts for tank and fish
mod_rep <- lmer(mass ~ treatment * measurement * sex + (1|tank) + (1|fish_id),
                data = df_long, REML = TRUE)

# Summary & Type-III ANOVA
summary(mod_rep)
anova(mod_rep, type = 3)

# R2 (marginal/conditional)
performance::r2(mod_rep)

# Post-hoc EMMeans
# a) Treatment differences within each measurement & sex
emm_treat_by_meas_sex <- emmeans(mod_rep, ~ treatment | measurement * sex)
pairs(emm_treat_by_meas_sex, adjust = "tukey")

# b) Before vs After (measurement) within each treatment & sex
emm_meas_by_treat_sex <- emmeans(mod_rep, ~ measurement | treatment * sex)
pairs(emm_meas_by_treat_sex, adjust = "tukey")

# Simple plot of marginal means (mean ± SE)
emmip(mod_rep, treatment ~ measurement | sex, CIs = TRUE)
```

```{r}
# Simulate scaled residuals
res_rep <- simulateResiduals(fittedModel = mod_rep, n = 2000)

# 1) Core DHARMa plots (QQ-uniformity, resid vs fitted, etc.)
plot(res_rep)

# 2) Formal tests
testUniformity(res_rep)   # want non-significant
testDispersion(res_rep)   # mainly for non-Gaussian, but fine to check
testOutliers(res_rep)

# 3) Residuals vs key predictors (look for trends / heteroskedasticity)
plotResiduals(res_rep, df_long$treatment,   main = "Residuals vs treatment")
plotResiduals(res_rep, df_long$measurement, main = "Residuals vs measurement")
plotResiduals(res_rep, df_long$sex,         main = "Residuals vs sex")
plotResiduals(res_rep, df_long$body_length, main = "Residuals vs body_length")

# 4) Residual distribution across random-effect levels
boxplot(res_rep$scaledResiduals ~ df_long$tank, las = 2,
        main = "Scaled residuals by tank", ylab = "Scaled residuals")

# ---- Save plots (optional) ----
png("DHARMa_rep_core.png", width = 1200, height = 900, res = 120)
plot(res_rep)
dev.off()

png("DHARMa_rep_by_predictor.png", width = 1400, height = 1200, res = 130)
par(mfrow = c(2,2))
plotResiduals(res_rep, df_long$treatment,   main = "Residuals vs treatment")
plotResiduals(res_rep, df_long$measurement, main = "Residuals vs measurement")
plotResiduals(res_rep, df_long$sex,         main = "Residuals vs sex")
plotResiduals(res_rep, df_long$body_length, main = "Residuals vs body_length")
dev.off()

png("DHARMa_rep_by_tank.png", width = 1400, height = 600, res = 130)
boxplot(res_rep$scaledResiduals ~ df_long$tank, las = 2,
        main = "Scaled residuals by tank", ylab = "Scaled residuals")
dev.off()
```
